title: THE HUD REGISTRY
why: His orders of 2026-10-14: the whole game needs a UI clean up, and nothing in the raid HUD may land on anything else. This build only measures. Every piece of the raid HUD now says where it drew this frame, in screen pixels, under its name (the score block, the alert, the boss bar, the minimap, the info panel, the gun card, the feed, the belt, the air strike plate, the power-up chips, the item in hand, the lore card, the status icons, the vitals, the weapon corner, the controls list, the pillagers board and the teammate rows), and one function lists every pair that shares a pixel and every piece off the screen. The next builds clear what it finds.
now: Every piece of the raid HUD now registers its screen rectangle, so overlaps can be listed and checked.
